section_header: AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSION — Component Groups (Overdrive Input Shaft and Clutch)
title: AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSION — Component Groups (Overdrive Input Shaft and Clutch)

content.description: Illustration showing removal of snap ring and hub from overdrive clutch assembly, with hands using tools to remove components

items: REMOVE SNAP RING AND HUB FROM OVERDRIVE CLUTCH ASSEMBLY
REMOVE THINNER SNAP RING, FLANGE, DISC AND PLATE

content.description: Illustration showing compression of piston return springs using SST tool and removal of snap ring

items: COMPRESS PISTON RETURN SPRINGS AND REMOVE SNAP RING

content.text: Using SST on the spring retainer and compress the springs with a shop press. Using a screwdriver, remove the snap ring.

items: REMOVE SPRING RETAINER AND EIGHTEEN SPRINGS

content.description: Illustration showing assembly of overdrive clutch on oil pump and piston removal process

items: ASSEMBLE OVERDRIVE CLUTCH ON OIL PUMP AND BLOW OUT PISTON
(a) Slide the overdrive clutch onto the oil pump.
(b) Apply compressed air to an oil pump to remove the piston. (If the piston does not come out completely, use needle-nose pliers to remove it.)
(c) Remove the overdrive clutch from the oil pump.

content.description: Illustration showing removal of snap ring from overdrive planetary gear assembly

items: REMOVE SNAP RING FROM OVERDRIVE PLANETARY GEAR ASSEMBLY
REMOVE THRUST WASHERS AND ONE-WAY CLUTCH FROM PLANETARY GEAR ASSEMBLY

content.text: Be careful not to lose the four plugs.

content.description: Illustration showing removal of four plugs from planetary gear assembly using magnetic finger tool

items: REMOVE FOUR PLUGS WITH MAGNETIC FINGER

content.text: Keep the four plugs together to prevent losing them.
